_comment: Expected docxtpl-lint findings on python-docx-template's own tests/templates/*.docx. Everything not listed must be clean (0 false positives).

verify_unsupported.custom_jinja_filters_tpl.docx: custom filter my_filterB must be passed via jinja_env
